title: mime-tree public types missing PartialEq/Eq derives
description: ParsedHeader, ParsedPart, ParsedMessage, and DecodedBodyValue all derive Debug+Clone+Serialize+Deserialize but not PartialEq/Eq. All fields are String, Option<String>, u32, Vec<String>, Vec<ParsedPart>, Vec<ParsedHeader> — all of which implement PartialEq+Eq, so derive would produce the correct result. Callers who want to write assertions like 'assert_eq!(msg.headers[0], expected_header)' or compare ParsedPart trees cannot do so without writing boilerplate. Any caller using these types in a test must compare fields individually. Missing derives on public types forces callers to work around them — this is a usability defect in the API surface.
